answers.1:
kubectl set resources deployment rs351-web --requests=cpu=100m,memory=64Mi --limits=cpu=200m,memory=128Mi -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deployment/rs351-web -n $NS
kubectl get deployment rs351-web -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].resources}'

# Pod 템플릿이 바뀌므로 Pod 가 새로 만들어진다
answers.2:
kubectl get pod rs351-reader -n $NS -o yaml | grep -A8 resources
kubectl get pod rs351-reader -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].resources.limits.memory}' > /tmp/memlimit.txt
cat /tmp/memlimit.txt

# requests 값은 .resources.requests.memory 로 따로 있다
answers.3:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: rs351-yaml
spec:
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx:1.25
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 50m
        memory: 32Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 64Mi
EOF
kubectl get pod rs351-yaml -n $NS
answers.4:
kubectl get pod rs351-qos -n $NS -o yaml | tail -8
kubectl get pod rs351-qos -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.status.qosClass}' > /tmp/qos.txt
cat /tmp/qos.txt

# requests 와 limits 가 있지만 서로 다르면 Burstable
answers.6:
kubectl set resources deployment rs351-gu --requests=cpu=200m,memory=128Mi --limits=cpu=200m,memory=128Mi -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deployment/rs351-gu -n $NS
kubectl get pods -l app=rs351-gu -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.qosClass}'

# limits 만 정해도 requests 가 같은 값으로 채워져 Guaranteed 가 된다
answers.7:
kubectl run rs351-plain --image=nginx:1.25 -n $NS
kubectl wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.phase}'=Running pod/rs351-plain -n $NS --timeout=60s
kubectl get pod rs351-plain -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].resources.limits.memory}' > /tmp/default.txt
cat /tmp/default.txt
kubectl get limitrange -n $NS -o yaml | grep -A4 'default:'

# Pod 에 쓰지 않은 requests/limits 는 LimitRange 의 defaultRequest/default 로 채워진다
answers.9:
kubectl describe quota -n $NS
USED=$(kubectl get resourcequota -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.used.pods}')
HARD=$(kubectl get resourcequota -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.hard.pods}')
echo "$USED/$HARD" > /tmp/pods.txt
cat /tmp/pods.txt

# Used 는 쿼터가 세고 있는 현재 사용량, Hard 는 넘을 수 없는 한도
answers.10:
kubectl get deployment rs351-over -n $NS      # READY 0/1
kubectl describe replicaset -l app=rs351-over -n $NS | grep -A3 Events
kubectl get limitrange -n $NS -o yaml | grep -A3 'max:'
kubectl set resources deployment rs351-over --limits=cpu=500m,memory=64Mi -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deployment/rs351-over -n $NS

# LimitRange 의 max 를 넘으면 Deployment 는 만들어져도 Pod 가 거부된다
answers.11:
kubectl get deployment rs351-fat -n $NS        # READY 2/3
kubectl describe replicaset -l app=rs351-fat -n $NS | grep -i quota
kubectl describe quota -n $NS
kubectl set resources deployment rs351-fat --requests=cpu=50m,memory=200Mi --limits=cpu=100m,memory=256Mi -n $NS
kubectl rollout status deployment/rs351-fat -n $NS

# 쿼터는 Pod 를 하나씩 만들 때 합계가 Hard 를 넘는지 본다. 넘으면 그 Pod 만 거부된다
